description: An HTML file that contains embedded JavaScript defining a Calculator class extending Service, which registers methods and interacts with a ServiceManager.

classes.name: Calculator
classes.description: A class extending Service that provides 'add' and 'sub' methods for remote invocation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Calculates the sum of parameter array and returns a Promise resolving with the result.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Calculates the difference between first two parameters and returns a Promise resolving with the result.
